schedule.title: Schedule send
schedule.description: Send this message to “{name}” at the selected time.
schedule.customFirst: Set a separate first send time
schedule.customNext: Set a separate next send time
schedule.firstAfterInterval: Send first after one interval, then repeat at the same interval.
schedule.nextAfterInterval: Send next after one interval from now, then keep the same interval.
schedule.historyUnavailable: The task has started sending, changed, or its conversation has closed. This step cannot be restored; your current input is preserved.
schedule.repeatHint: Repeat at fixed intervals until the end condition is met. Missed rounds are skipped; failures or timeouts stop the schedule.
schedule.countProgress: Sent {sent}; {remaining} remaining. Only successful sends count.
schedule.countHint: Includes the first send; only successful sends count.
schedule.endAtHint: No new send starts after the cutoff. A send already in progress will finish.
schedule.invalidEndCount: Use a whole number from {min} to 10000, greater than the number already sent.
schedule.invalidEndTime: The end time must be on or after this send and within the next 365 days.
schedule.invalidEnd: The end condition no longer applies. Check the number already sent and choose again.
schedule.invalidInterval: Use a whole-number interval from 1 minute to 30 days.
schedule.keepOpenShort: Keep the app and conversation open
schedule.extendFrom: Send the same content once more after {time}.
schedule.extendRepeatHint: The original stays unchanged. The new message sends once; you can set it to repeat separately.
schedule.extendFailed: Could not append. The original time or status may have changed; reopen and try again.
schedule.invalidTime: Choose a future time within the next 30 days.
schedule.keepOpen: Keep CodexFlow and this conversation open. The message will be submitted automatically, including attachments. If your computer wakes more than 5 minutes late, reschedule it. Quitting the app cancels all scheduled messages.
schedule.saveFailed: Could not save the schedule. Your message is preserved; please try again.
schedule.unavailable: This conversation is unavailable or the message has already started sending.
schedule.limit: You can schedule up to 100 messages. Remove an existing schedule first.
schedule.cancelFailed: Could not cancel. The message may have started sending.
schedule.closeWarning: Closing this conversation also cancels its scheduled messages.

error.unavailable: The conversation has ended. The message is preserved.
error.sendFailed: Send failed. Check the terminal before rescheduling; part of the message may already have been pasted.
error.interrupted: The send result could not be confirmed. Check the conversation before rescheduling to avoid sending twice.
error.missed: The scheduled time has passed. Automatic sending has stopped; choose a new time.
